barchart.description: Values must be finite and non-negative; invalid values stay in source data but do not create bars or affect domains
barchart.brushDescription: Control the range with selection and onSelectionChange. The navigator keeps the full time domain while the bar chart filters the original observations. Clearing the range restores all data. Dates in this example use UTC.
barchart.rangeEmpty: No observations in this time range
barchart.contract: Values must be finite and non-negative; invalid values stay in source data but do not create bars or affect domains. barGap is a band ratio (0.2); barWidth, groupGap and stackGap use pixels. Default margin is 40px, entrance 1100ms, round caps and grow animation. Depth helpers never register extra series.
barchart.keyboard: Tab enters once; arrows, Home and End inspect data, Escape or blur clears the tooltip. Reduced motion disables decorative loops. ChartLegend layout/overflow are API options; inline/collapse fits multiple entries and folds overflow.
barchart.compatibility: Import shared tooltip and legend from chart-core. Existing chart/Recharts and chart-primitives APIs remain available with their own contracts.
